info.title: PayFlow Distributed Payment & Digital Wallet Platform API
info.description: Production-grade distributed payment and digital wallet platform engineered to Tier-1 fintech standards. Features Saga distributed transactions, zero-drift double-entry ledger, two-tier idempotency, and multi-channel notifications.
